title: Film tooling: per-scene speed, multi-part recordings, sidebar navigation helpers, phone frame, PDF viewer, AI request guard, driver recording parameters
why: The owner found the master film rushed: no visible navigation, AI results never opened, automations not shown. New films (starting with a prospect demo) need sped-up data entry with a visible marker, sidebar navigation on camera, opened PDFs and phone-sized pages, and a hard AI request budget. Everything here is generic; prospect content stays in the gitignored prospects/ folder.
source: prospects/skanda/SPEC-PLAN.md section 3 (G1-G8). G9 (customer email in the local outbox) is already done by R142.

items.what: Per-scene playback speed in the studio
items.detail: screen and phone scenes accept speed (1, 1.5, 2, 3 or 4; default 1) and speedLabel (default 'Sped up {speed}x'; false hides it). build.mjs: the recorded segment's screen time is (out - in) / speed, used for minDur; keep speed and speedLabel on the timeline scene. ScreenClip/PhoneClip: rate = speed * (sceneLen > segLen / speed ? max(0.8, (segLen / speed) / sceneLen) : 1); playFrames = floor((segLen / rate) * fps); pass playbackRate to OffthreadVideo. When speed > 1 render SpeedBadge (small pill, top right of the window, fades in over 8 frames). Narration is never sped up. A scene without speed renders exactly as today.
items.test: A render of an existing catalogue clip is unchanged (compare the timeline JSON before and after); a small fixture clip with a 4x scene renders with the badge and the right duration.

items.detail: beat() holds for (narration seconds + 0.65) x speed of its scene; loadBeats reads speed from the clip scene. recordFilm(page, context, name, testInfo, body, { clip }) loads the beats of clip `clip` (default name) whose scenes' recording is `name`, so one clip can be recorded in several parts. navTo(page, href), hoverNav(page, hrefs, dwellMs), tab(page, name): visible sidebar navigation and sub-tabs using the real sidebar (desktop/src/components/layout/nav-config.ts). showInPhoneFrame(page, url): like showMail, a phone-sized frame around a same-origin page. showPdf(page, file): renders a downloaded PDF's pages with pdf.js, loaded from node_modules through page.route (no CDN). aiGuard(page, { budget, live }): counts AI requests the browser makes (non-GET under /api/v1/ai/ except /ai/settings, plus /marketing/social-content/generate*, /marketing/suggestions/generate, and the GETs that generate on open: /ai/bi/(cash-flow-forecast|destination-profitability|lost-deal-analysis|seasonal-demand|team-performance), /ai/intelligence/insights*), plus server(n) for server-side reads; throws before the count exceeds budget; report() logs it. Generalise the counter in ai-session.spec.ts and make ai-session use aiGuard.
items.dependency: pdfjs-dist is needed as a devDependency of desktop. Do NOT run npm install (node_modules are junctions into the main checkout). Check whether pdfjs-dist (or another PDF renderer) is already installed anywhere under node_modules; if yes use it; if not, stop that one helper and report that the orchestrator must add the dependency in the main checkout.
items.test: A small Playwright spec under desktop/e2e/showcase/films/ (or a unit test) that exercises beat speed, navTo/tab on a local stack, showInPhoneFrame and aiGuard (budget 0 throws on a fake AI request intercepted by page.route, so no live AI call).

items.detail: The raw-take duration gate sums line x speed per scene. --clip <id> records a film that is not in docs/videos/films.json when its clip carries film: { stack, targetSec }, so prospect films use the same retake, gate and render path.
A recording named driver-* is a driver recording: video desktop/showcase/.work/<name>.mp4, marks desktop/showcase/.work/<name>-marks.json (today only the exact name driver is special).

Parameters -Test (integration test file, default integration_test/demo_flow_test.dart), -AgencyCode (passed as --dart-define=AGENCY_CODE), and the marks file named after -Out (<base>-marks.json; unchanged driver-marks.json for the default). Flutter only through the x86 PowerShell (the script already does this).

A short 'Prospect films' section (files live in gitignored prospects/<name>/, studio/clips/prospect-*.json and desktop/e2e/showcase/films/prospect-*.spec.ts are gitignored, the --clip path, the AI guard) and the speed field in the clip schema.

rules: No prospect names or content in any committed file.
Catalogue films must behave exactly as before: node docs/videos/coverage.mjs prints OK; a scene without speed is unchanged.
No live AI requests; no rendering of the full catalogue (one small fixture render only).
studio/ is its own npm project: do not install anything there either; report a missing dependency.
gates: desktop npm run typecheck + node scripts/lint-gate.mjs
studio: its own typecheck if it has one (check studio/package.json scripts)
one fixture render through node studio/src/build.mjs
